[Backup plan] If results are poor, simplify entry to just Bollinger breakout with a trailing stop loss. If Sharpe is low, increase ADX threshold to 30 and add a 20-period moving average filter. As an alternative, switch to a mean reversion approach using Bollinger bands with volatility scaling and dynamic position sizing.
